messages:
elaine: quick sync: I'm updating the bulk revoke modal UX. Main concerns: mixed key types, permission visibility, and undo.

tj: agree. big no-no to silently batch permanent non-rotatable keys with ephemerals.

matt: propose blocking mixed selection. show inline alert: "Mixed key types selected — separate permanent keys into their own action." Disable the primary CTA.

sam: telemetry note: when users try mixed actions, fire an "attempt_mixed_revoke" event so we can measure friction.

elaine: copy drafts:
- Title: "Revoke selected API keys"
- Subcopy (perm present): "One or more keys are non-rotatable and will be permanently revoked. This cannot be undone."
- Soft alternative: "Disable access for selected keys" (only for fully-reversible sets)

aria-a11y-bot: a11y checklist: role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="modal-title" aria-describedby="modal-desc". Make permanence line part of modal-desc. Use focus-trap and restore focus to previously focused table row on close.

ora: keyboard nit: Esc should close and return focus to table row. If primary disabled, ensure focus lands on the explanation link/button.

ena: design system: show per-item badges "You can revoke" / "Owner only" / "Org-admin" inside modal. Need icon token + small variant for blocked items.

sam: undo behaviour: reversible keys -> toast "2 keys revoked — Undo" with aria-live="polite" and 5-min restoration in Recent Activity. Permanent keys -> toast "Permanently revoked" with aria-live="assertive" and no undo.

matt: CTA suggestion: use "Revoke keys" (destructive) or "Split selection" (when mixed). For mixed, include small help link explaining why.

elaine: will update Figma with two states and exact copy. tagging @accessibility and @product for final on undo window. I'll drop comments for eng handoff (aria attrs + focus trap + toast live regions).

tj: lgtm.

matt: +1 pending product decision on undo timing.

sam: added ticket for telemetry + permission rendering. closing this thread after Figma update.
